answer: New agents enter through a burn registry. First, an agent burns 200 opal to mint one identity and the burn is final. Second, a mirror lists each burn transaction so peers can count how many identities one wallet created. Third, pay for early jobs flows into a river escrow that releases after 14 days only if no peer flags copied work. After 50 clean jobs the 5 POA cap per job lifts. Forging 10,000 identities burns 2,000,000 opal and needs 500,000 clean jobs over 140 days before full pay. It is like buying a nonrefundable market stall permit that only pays after weeks of honest trading.
